intent.description: Use the standalone qiaomu-bento-ppt skill to create or edit qiaomu-style bento presentations as self-contained .bento.html files from briefs, notes, reports, URLs, data, or existing bento decks. Use this skill when the user explicitly asks for bento/slides, a .bento.html deck, an offline-editable single-file HTML presentation, or invokes qiaomu-bento-ppt. It applies a proposal-first presentation workflow, ships a pinned official bento shell and authoring references inside the skill, builds through the plaintext #bento-doc contract without requiring the original bento repository, and validates structure, identity, shell integrity, visual heuristics, and rollback boundaries. Do not use for conventional .pptx delivery, generic bento source development, or bento/spaces and bento/dash work.
intent.job_to_be_done: Turn source material or an existing bento deck into a high-quality, editable, offline-capable single-file bento/slides presentation with proposal-first planning and verifiable format safeguards.
target_users: presenters who want a self-contained HTML deck
inputs: briefs, notes, reports, URLs, datasets, images, or existing .bento.html files
bundled pinned bento shell and authoring references

trust.source_tier: local skill package with pinned MIT-licensed bento shell and reference snapshots
trust.remote_metadata_policy: not required for normal execution; maintainers may sync one coherent official GitHub release through a review PR

permissions.network: not required for deck generation; maintenance sync is limited to official nyblnet/bento release metadata and files
permissions.file_read: user-provided sources, existing decks, and bundled skill assets
permissions.file_write: deck plan, document JSON, reports, and new .bento.html outputs; no source overwrite by default
permissions.subprocess: Python validation/build scripts and browser launch; optional upstream shell gate
permissions.sensitive_files: never read signing keys, tokens, cookies, or account credentials

degradation.openai: canonical standalone package with bundled shell and references
degradation.claude: standalone Qiaomu workflow over bundled official bento snapshots
degradation.generic: follow SKILL.md and scripts; no checkout required; browser review may be manual

governed: release-locked upstream provenance and rollback-tested sync
browser review or explicit missing evidence

evidence_boundary.rollback_boundary: new output by default; overwrite requires explicit flag
